description: Two-book strategy classification (docs/INVESTMENTS-PAGE-SPEC.md, 'Strategy model & policy deviations'). CORE = $1T+ durables: never sell, delta-10 covered calls, forced exits must be recovered (re-buy or sell puts until re-assigned). INVENTORY = volatile wheel names: sell puts for premium, on assignment exit via delta-20 calls; holding them passively is the deviation. Symbols are Neel's declaration, not an API lookup — edit here when policy changes. Seeded by Claude 2026-07-12 from known market caps; TSLA and IBIT classifications flagged for Neel's review. GOOG added 2026-07-22 alongside GOOGL -- same company (Alphabet Class C vs Class A), was incorrectly falling through to 'unclassified'/Tier-2 wheel treatment. AMD classified Inventory 2026-07-22 (market cap $924B just under $1T, trading history matched wheel behavior) then moved to Core 2026-07-23 on Neel's explicit override -- his call, not a data correction. TSM and MRVL added 2026-08-08 as AI value-chain thesis targets (data/allocation_targets.json) -- both were unclassified and would have fallen through to Tier-2 wheel treatment once held. TSM -> Core on the $1T+ rule. MRVL -> Inventory on the same rule (~$180B), but FLAGGED FOR NEEL: the thesis makes MRVL the largest Infrastructure AI position at a 9.6% target, and Inventory treatment means ATM exit calls that wheel it straight back out. If it is meant to be held, move it to Core -- same override AMD got. ZM added to Core 2026-09-04 on Neel's explicit override, NOT the $1T+ rule (Zoom is ~$30B). Neel sold a deliberately aggressive ITM $100 put in his Brokerage to be assigned 100 shares: he wants to be in Zoom. Core here means delta-10/15 far-OTM calls for income WITHOUT getting called away -- the default Inventory treatment would have written ATM calls that wheel the shares straight back out, the exact opposite of the intent behind the put. Same shape of override as AMD (2026-07-23) and the one still open on MRVL. NOTE: this list is now the SINGLE source of Tier-1 for v6_engine.py, which used to keep its own hardcoded copy (they had drifted -- TSM was here but not there). Adding a symbol here is the whole change; there is no second list to edit.
